messages:
anna_cs: Heads-up — spend-bot flagged AcmeCorp for a notable spend jump this week vs their monthly commit. Can someone sanity-check if this is expected ramp or an anomaly? :eyes:
spend-bot: Account: AcmeCorp
  commit_monthly: $12,000
  current_week_spend: $4,650
  projected_month: $18,600
  flag: spend > commit * 1.5 (auto-flag)
  drivers: generation tokens + embeddings (preliminary)
```
acct_id: ACME-9931
top_routes: /v1/generate (71%), /v1/embeddings (22%)
avg_tokens_per_call: 420
```
mark_acct: Oof, that projected month is above their commit. Do we know if they enabled any new feature or test env?
anna_cs: Not that I can see in onboarding notes. They did a small rollout last Tuesday but expected to be low-volume.
ryan_devx: I can look at route-level breakdowns — will check whether it's a burst or sustained pattern. Give me ~30m.
julia_success: Also check latency/error rate so we can see if it's a retry loop causing extra tokens. If embeddings error and client retries, spend spikes.
infra-bot: Quick metrics (last 7d vs prior 7d):
  95th_latency: 210ms (was 188ms, +12%)
  error_rate: 0.32% (was 0.08%, +0.24pp)
  retry_signals: +3 incidents of 5xx from a single client IP
mark_acct: That error bump could explain some retries. Can we correlate the 5xx timestamps to spikes in token usage?
ryan_devx: Pulling query logs now — initial glance shows daily peak around 03:00 UTC with long responses from /v1/generate. Could be a batch job.
anna_cs: I'll ping the Acme technical contact to ask about any scheduled batch jobs or model switch. @mark_acct do you want to lead that outreach?
mark_acct: Yep, looping them in. Drafting a quick note: "we noticed higher-than-usual usage and a small increase in errors — could you confirm any recent changes?"
julia_success: Also propose a short call if they confirm it was intended so we can discuss commit adjustment vs burst protection.
spend-bot: Suggestion: set a spend alert at 90% of commit and enable burst protection policy to cap hourly spend. (Admin link: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/ACME-9931/spend)
anna_cs: Good rec. If they intended the ramp, we should offer a temporary overage plan + recommendation to move to Dedicated if sustained.
mark_acct: I'll wait for their reply before making contract suggestions. If it's an unintended anomaly, we should offer to temporarily rollback or throttle.
ryan_devx: Confirmed correlation: three long-running generated responses between 03:12–03:45 UTC produced 3x tokens compared to baseline — same IP that saw 5xx. Looks like a retry/timeout spiral.
julia_success: Action items: 1) mark to contact customer (mark_acct) 2) ops to investigate and mitigate retries (ryan_devx + infra) 3) propose temporary spend alert & mitigation (anna_cs)
anna_cs: Assigned. I'll update the health dashboard and flag renewal risk if they hit >120% of commit for the month.
mark_acct: Customer replied — they had a nightly data-enrichment job accidentally pointed to prod endpoints. They've paused it and will redeploy to staging. They asked if we can credit the accidental overage.
julia_success: Noted for billing review — we'll escalate to Finance for any goodwill credit.
anna_cs: Thanks team. Closing loop: once infra confirms no ongoing retries, I'll mark anomaly resolved in the weekly health doc. :white_check_mark:
